full_judgment: 9. Mr. Ramjan Ali Sikder with Mr. Abu Khaled-al-Mamun appearing for the petitioner referred to section 81 of the customs Act and submits that the petitioners goods were assessed provisionally on 23-3-2001 and the respondent had to make final assessment within a period of 150 working days. In the instant case that was not done. He further submits that the respondent issued the impugned notice on 22-6-2003, and 07-9-2004 which are long after 150 working days, therefore, the impugned order is illegal as barred by limitation.
